name: xit
description: Compress noisy terminal output before it reaches Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Compress terminal noise and save Codex context.
interface.longDescription: XiT detects high-output terminal commands, compresses noisy output, preserves errors and key evidence, and reduces the context sent to Codex. Supports Codex mode inside the ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI, and Codex IDE through the shared Codex configuration and hook system — no separate installation needed for any of them. Once automatic mode is set up for a project (`xit chatgpt setup --auto`), high-output commands are rerouted through XiT by a deterministic hook — no need to select this plugin or mention XiT every time.
